chunks: Murāzim narrated from the righteous servant Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليهما السلام, who said:

If a grave matter afflicts you, then give charity during your day to sixty needy people, giving each needy person half a sāʿ by the sāʿ of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله from dates, wheat, or barley. Then, when it is night, perform ghusl in the last third of the night, then wear the humblest clothes worn by those whom you support, except that in those clothes you should have a waist-wrapper; then pray two rakʿahs.
In them, you recite al-Tawḥīd and: «قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ».

Then when you place your forehead in prostration in the final rakʿah, declare the oneness of Allah, sanctify Him, magnify Him, and glorify Him. Then remember your sins, admitting those you know of specifically, and those you do not know of in a general way. Then raise your head, and when you place your forehead in the second prostration, seek Allah's counsel one hundred times, saying: 'O Allah, indeed I seek Your counsel by Your knowledge.' Then supplicate to Allah by whatever of His names you wish, and say: 'O One existing before everything, O Originator of everything, O One existing after everything, do for me such-and-such and such-and-such.'

And whenever you prostrate, press your knees to the ground and raise the waist-wrapper until you uncover them, and place the waist-wrapper behind you between your buttocks and the inner parts of your legs. For I hope that your need will be fulfilled, if Allah the Exalted wills. And begin with blessings upon the Prophet and the people of his Household, may the blessings of Allah be upon them all.

key_terms.اسْتَخَرْتَ: you seek Allah’s choice and guidance
key_terms.حَاجَتُكَ: your need or request sought from Allah
key_terms.ذُنُوبَكَ: your sins which are to be confessed before Allah
key_terms.صَاعٍ: a prophetic measure of food used here for charity
key_terms.فَدَحَكَ: afflicted you severely with a burdensome matter
key_terms.مِسْكِينًا: a needy person eligible to receive charity

ai.seo_question: What should a person do in Islam when faced with a grave hardship and seeking fulfillment of a need?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a prayer of need for times of severe distress, combining charity, ritual purity, salat, confession of sins, and du'a. It emphasizes humility before Allah, seeking His guidance through His knowledge, and beginning one's supplication with salawat upon the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and his Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.
